title: Advertising - Worldwide
highlights: Ad spending in the Advertising market worldwide is forecasted to reach US$1.25tn in 2026.
The largest market is TV & Video Advertising with a market volume of US$383.20bn in 2026.
When considering global figures, the United States leads with ad spending projected at US$513.00bn in 2026.
In the Advertising market, 84.1% of total ad spending will come from digital sources in 2031.
The average ad spending per capita in the In-App Advertising market is expected to be US$57.40 in 2026.
By 2031, Advertising market of 84.2% revenue will be generated through programmatic advertising.
In the worldwide Advertising market, digital platforms like Facebook and Google dominate ad spending, reshaping traditional media landscapes globally.
